profile.description: A'Sharqiya Investment Holding Co. (SAOG) engages in the investment, development, leasing, and maintenance of real estate properties in the Sultanate of Oman. The company operates through two segments, Investments and Leasing. It engages in listed and private equity investment activities. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Muscat, the Sultanate of Oman.
